verification_evidence: Historical implementation revision 5a861989 passed GitHub Actions run 41106211194. Later local checks and eight hosted live-operation passes are recorded separately in the dated local and hosted validation reports. The final hosting source passed nine regression tests and typechecking; this does not assert new public-repository CI.
live_summary: Eight hosted integrations passed live operations on 7 November 2026. OpenAI passed a local direct test but is disabled and untested on the Site; ElevenLabs remains parked. Seven alternatives remain unimplemented or deferred.
